content: #2 Is there a good concise name for the functions that appear in the Paley-Wiener-Schwartz theorem as the Fourier-Laplace transform of compactly supported distributions? It is tempting to say something like “polynomially bounded”, but that’s not quite right. Is there a good name?
subject: Paley-Wiener-Schwartz theorem
